scientific_diagnosis.finding: Active set contracted by 98.8% (from 13803 down to 160 nodes), but delta_d plateaued at 9.1699e-03 +/- 5.5327e-04 (CV=0.060). This demonstrates localized nonlinear damage redistribution at the crack-tip nodes rather than divergent oscillation or uniform geometric contraction. Damping parameter omega_d=0.5 alone is insufficient to contract the crack-tip boundary without localized acceleration.
scientific_diagnosis.falsified_hypothesis: Uniform convex damage under-relaxation (omega_d=0.5) induces geometric contraction of the coupled system across all mesh nodes.
scientific_diagnosis.next_investigation_recommendation: Test localized adaptive damping / Anderson acceleration specifically targeting the 160 active crack-tip nodes under strict non-healing constraints.
